run_train_baseline: run the train_baseline function to train a BERT model with raw torchao FP8 conversion
run_train_integration: run the train_integration function to train a BERT model using accelerate with FP8 mixed precision
run_evaluate_model: run the evaluate_model function to compute accuracy and F1 metrics on a validation dataloader
test_filter_linear_layers: test the filter_linear_layers function to skip first and last linear layers for FP8 stability
run_benchmark_comparison: run the main block to compare baseline torchao FP8 training results against accelerate FP8 integration
